note: Python `easy-personal schedule` runs frozen as goldens (T034). Per scenario file: runs; each run has before (the steps done since the previous run), argv, env_extra, fake_systemctl, exit_code, stdout, stderr (kind only), files, dirs, systemctl_calls.

scenarios.what: the three dry runs (nothing written, no systemctl call), and the install dry run with no systemctl
a real install, a second install with --retention-days, remove, remove with nothing installed
remove calls systemctl only when the timer file existed; a missing file is fine
no systemctl on PATH: the message and the cron line, exit 1, nothing written
systemctl present but `--user show-environment` fails: the same message, only that one call
Python: traceback, exit 1; the unit files are already written; the calls stop at the failing one
Python: traceback, exit 1; files stay when disable fails, are gone when the last daemon-reload fails
Python: traceback, exit 1; install stops before systemctl runs, remove stops after `disable`
the unit folder: XDG_CONFIG_HOME, else HOME/.config (empty counts as unset); a relative one stays relative
bad arguments: exit 2, nothing written, no systemctl call
the command is shlex-quoted: plain, space, quotes, non-ASCII, shell characters, and the characters that stay bare

tokens.<CASE>: the scenario's temp folder (home/, xdg/, data/, bin/)
tokens.<CMD>: <CASE>/bin/easy-personal, the stub the command is found at (every scenario but Q01)
